name: Additive levels of detail for Gaussian splats
definition: An order-optimisation framework for streaming progressive loading of Gaussian splats, building additive ladders where each rung adds detail without replacing previous data.
summary: Additive levels of detail for Gaussian splats is an order-optimization framework that streams scene data by accumulating splats in priority ladders rather than swapping them, ensuring efficient progressive loading without replacing previously rendered primitives.
